item.title: Mardi Gras in the Minden community is successful
item.description: Despite a cold, cutting wind, Minden and surrounding community residents celebrated Mardi Gras Saturday in the annual event. The parade was well-attended and folks enjoyed food trucks, restaurants, and games for the kids.

item.title: Amelia Lott crowned new Apache Princess
item.description: A new Apache Princess was crowned Saturday night for Glenbrook School. The Princess and her court from left: Third runner-up, Mollie Thurman, First runner-up, Chloe Gregg, Apache Princess & Miss Congeniality, Amelia Lott and Second runner-up, Landry Edwards.

item.title: Ordinances will change the face of Minden
item.description: By Bonnie Culverhouse An ordinance that will allow the City of Minden to establish an administrative court was approved unanimously at Monday night’s council meeting. item.title: Unpaid invoices end Springhill dispatch for Cullen
item.description: By Tiffany Flournoy CULLEN, La. — The Town of Cullen’s failure to pay longstanding dispatching invoices has forced the Springhill Police Department to stop providing dispatch services for the Cullen Police Department, effective immediately, Springhill Police Will Lynd confirmed Saturday.
